title: Houthis used Anthropic AI to try to build ballistic missiles

reports.title: Houthis used Anthropic AI to try to build ballistic missiles

summary:
The Financial Times reports that Yemen's Houthi movement used artificial intelligence software from the company Anthropic in an effort to build ballistic missiles. The available text does not say when this attempt took place, which specific Anthropic product was involved, or whether the effort succeeded. It also does not name any individual Houthi members or Anthropic employees.

The rest of the article is behind a subscription paywall, so the key numbers, such as how many people were involved or how much money was spent, are not provided. The text does not state what happens next, including any response from Anthropic, the Yemeni government, or other countries. Only the headline and subscription prompts are visible, so a fuller summary is not possible from the given material.
